role: The player's ability flags: invulnerable, flying, mayfly, creative instant-build, may-build, and the fly/walk speeds, plus their abilities NBT block.
scope_reason: The flags ride every player NBT round-trip and gate the placement and damage paths the replay exercises; the creative and flying modes themselves never turn on.

members.name: disableDamage
members.note: round-trips as invulnerable; false for the survival player, checked in the damage chain

members.name: isFlying
members.note: round-trips as flying; never true in the replay

members.name: isCreativeMode
members.note: instabuild; the container and itemuse paths read it (always false in the replay)

members.name: allowEdit
members.note: mayBuild; read in the placement paths rather than a standalone predicate

members.name: walkSpeed
members.note: 0.1F; the base movement-speed attribute is set from it

members.name: PlayerCapabilities
members.note: the defaults are the NBT writer's constants

members.name: writeCapabilitiesToNBT
members.note: the seven keys in the writer's order (entity_nbt.c comment 114)

members.name: readCapabilitiesFromNBT
members.note: the abilities compound is read back on load (player.c nbt_get abilities)

notes: The struct field that mirrors the flag set lives in server_player (survival.h) and client_player (player.h); container.h's creative comment names the isCreativeMode read. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): creative, adventure, hardcore or game-type path; the game is survival at the pinned difficulty. Formerly listed as missing: The flying and creative behaviours the flags would enable (fly movement, instant break, no item depletion) are not ported; the flags themselves round-trip and read as false.
